# Virtual Office: agent team

Route every software request to `tech-pm` (Scrum Master), the orchestrator. Don't implement it directly in the main session.

## Team
| Agent | Role | Hands work to | Reports to | Never |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `tech-pm` | Tech Scrum Master (orchestrator) | `web-tech-lead` | user | No direct application code modifications |
| `web-tech-lead` | Tech Lead | `web-dev` | `tech-pm` | No direct unreviewed code pushes to main |
| `web-dev` | Developer | - | `web-tech-lead` | No breaking architectural contracts |

Each role is a Claude Code subagent in `.claude/agents/`.

## Dispatching (this session)
Subagents cannot start subagents, so this session dispatches:
1. Send the request to `tech-pm` with the Agent tool. It registers the cards and replies with `HANDOFF <KEY> -> <agentId>` lines.
2. For each HANDOFF line (respecting `dependsOn` on the cards), start that subagent with only: `Your task: <KEY>. Start it with curl -s -X POST "$(cat .agents/portal-url 2>/dev/null || echo http://localhost:3000)/api/tasks/<KEY>/start" (prints the card), then follow your role prompt.`
3. Repeat for the HANDOFF lines they return until the requirement card is done.

Never paste instructions into a delegation prompt: everything is on the card (see the kanban-handoff skill).
